lessons.objective: Learner can understand, explain and apply informational reading.
teaching_sequence: Begin with an original short example connected to the learner's life.
Ask what the learner notices before giving formal explanation.
Model how to use textual clues or context.
Guide one response, then remove support.
Ask for an original example or retelling.
lessons.checkpoint: Explain informational reading without notes and solve a new example.

interactive_activities.title: Explore informational reading
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on informational reading. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where India’s diversity is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach oral/written presentation to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
